notes.title: C.H.A.S.E.R. is Now Human-Like (And fully released!)
notes.content:
After a couple months of continued development, we're excited to announce the official rebranding from C.H.A.S.E.R. to Human-Like. Here are some of the things we've added:

[list]
[*] The taser is now replaced with an EMP blast that can hit the bot from both ways.
[*] More sound effects! 
[*] New scoring system
[*] Global leaderboards visible from the Steam community hub
[*] Leaderboards that show friends in game!
[*] Various bugfixes
[/list]

We've also decided to move out of early access! 

Check out our latest blogpost [url=https://strife.ai/blog/dev-diary-the-rebrand]on why we've decided to go down the path of rebranding[/url]

Also feel free to join our [url=https://discord.gg/7uEsyHF]Discord Channel[/url] and talk with us! We're always open to feedback!

notes.title: CHASER Gamepad Support Update
notes.content:
Today we're excited to be releasing our first of bi-weekly updates to the public! As of this update, controllers are now supported! If you have run CHASER before this update, you will need to reset the controls to take advantage of controller support (or bind the game pad's buttons manually). Default bindings can be reset by pressing the "Reset Controls" button in the settings menu.

Some other changes we've made include:
[list]
[*] Easier to read fonts have been included for certain aspects of the user interface.
[*] A Discord invite link has also been added to the settings menu.
[*] A button for reporting bugs has also been added directly to the pause menu.
[*] The arcade mode restarts immediately after death.
[*] The current base game has been rebranded as an arcade mode. Now with the "run" being renamed to "arcade". We hope to bring more of a survival horror campaign mode as the main game later on. 
[/list]

We'd love to hear your feedback on our [url=https://discord.gg/rNrKTKY]Discord channel[/url] feel free to stop by and give us your feedback or talk about machine learning and games.

notes.title: Small Community Feedback Update
notes.content:
[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]
Here are a couple items to address feedback from the community:
[list]
[*] The HUD now displays "Remaining Cores" to highlight how far you are in the current run
[*] Item boxes will no longer give you duplicate items, i.e. you can't have two of the same item simultaneously
[/list]
Enhancements:
[list]
[*] New sprites for speedboost and taser items.
[/list]

[h1]Coming Soon[/h1]
[list]
[*] Additional map segments that are much more difficult than what currently exists
[*] Introduction of Steam achievements
[*] More environmental and character sound effects.
[/list]

[h1]Experiments[/h1]
We're also experimenting with additional features to create more replayability:
[list]
[*] A scoring/stats system so that you can track how your skill at the game is increasing.
[*] A modifier system so that you can increase the game's challenge to your liking. For example, always speed boosted mode, max darkness, or multi-bot runs.
[/list]
The above changes will be part of our journey to creating a leaderboard and weekly challenges so that you can compete with your friends. 

Let us know what you think about these potential features or any feedback you may have in the comments below or on the [url=https://discord.gg/7uEsyHF]Strife AI Discord channel[/url]!
